ruling.recommended_action: Close the case: the driver-tapped arrival with 490 s of in-radius waiting meets NS-1 (i)–(iii) at the case-record 8-minute threshold, so the cancellation fee stands; no refund and no account action. Note for Ryde: the rider complaint concerns a $5.00 fee while the trace parameters give the cancellation fee as $5.00.
ruling.reasoning:
The dispute is a no-show cancellation with cancelled_by = driver, so it enters through NS-0 and is tested against NS-1 / NS-2 [F4][F7][NS-0]. The case record sets the no-show threshold at 8 minutes, so NS-1 (iii) requires at least 8 minutes of continuous waiting inside the pickup radius after the arrival confirmation rather than Ryde's default 3 minutes (the record's threshold governs; the trace accepts the 8-min threshold as reached) [F6][NS-1].

All three NS-1 elements are settled by the records. (i) Arrival was confirmed by the driver's own tap, not a platform auto-detection: "I'm Here" at 12:17:10 [F6][NS-1]. (ii) At the moment of that tap the driver was 39 m from the pickup point, well inside the 200 m parameter, and his closest approach to the pickup was 6 m [F6][F1][NS-1]. (iii) He then remained continuously within 200 m for 8 min 10 s (490 s) until cancelling at 12:25:20, which is at least the 480 s threshold, and the GPS trace covers the whole wait with no gap [F2][F3][F6][NS-1]. The driver's chat "At the pickup now" at 12:17 and "8 min up, cancelling the trip" at 12:25 are consistent with that timeline [F9][F10][F11]. The driver's post-trip statement adds nothing that is needed, since the system records already settle every element [F12][NS-1].

Because NS-1 is fully satisfied, the $5.00 cancellation fee on record is valid and no refund arises under NS-2 [F4][F7][F8][NS-2]. The fee equals the record's cancellation-fee parameter, and there is no unpublished add-on to strip under FARE-1 [F7][FARE-1]. The driver's profile (2 prior upheld no-show disputes, 824 trips) is irrelevant to whether this particular no-show was established — a profile fact may never decide a case alone — and since RD-2 yields no refund and no route-violation finding is recorded, RD-6's flag condition is not met [F17][RD-6].

Safety screen: I read both chat messages, the driver's statement and the rider's complaint. Nothing in them is a threat, intimidation, harassment, or a dangerous-driving allegation; the messages are a pickup notification, a cancellation notice and a factual complaint about being charged after the driver cancelled [F9][F10][F12][SAFE-1]. Nothing in the traffic or weather facts suggests a road-safety event [F13][F14][F15]. Evidence status: sufficient — the GPS trace, timeline and fare records settle NS-1 (i)–(iii) and the fee, and the chat record is complete and timestamped [F11][NS-1].
